headline: Spaces shaped by *light* and place.
intro: Archrist Infra is an architecture and construction studio serving in and around Tuticorin . We design homes and workspaces that respond to their climate, their site and the people who use them, and we see each project through from first drawings to handover.
quote: “Good architecture begins with listening, to the site, to the climate, and to the people who will live there.”
studioText: [A few paragraphs about the practice: training, how the studio works with clients, and the places it builds in.]
